Hand-authored fixture for the Vertex :rawPredict adapter, replayable without
any network. The response is a valid Messages-format 200; the request is the
exact compact body the adapter sends for model claude-sonnet-4-5, system
prompt "S", max_tokens 1024, and input "hello".

Settlement this fixture pins:
  - billed input 1600 = 1000 fresh + 100 cache writes + 500 cache reads
  - output 200
  - cost 7178 micro-USD = 6525 base (3525 input + 3000 output) + 653 regional
    (the docs/debt.md#41(d) 10% multiplier, rounded up)

Recorded against a live API? No. KNO_LIVE_TESTS=1 recording is refused for
this fixture: a recorded request body would need a real service-account key,
and the key is exactly what fixtures must not carry.
